title: InferCept: Efficient Intercept Support for Augmented Large Language Model Inference
technique: min-waste handling of API/tool interceptions: chunked recomputation, chunked swap, per-request choice among discard/preserve/swap by memory-waste equations

optimized_metrics.evidence: INFERCEPT minimizes the GPU resource waste caused by LLM interceptions and dedicates saved memory for serving more requests.
INFERCEPT improves the overall serving throughput by 1.6x-2x and completes 2x more requests per second compared to the state-of-the-art LLM inference systems.
serving throughput as normalized latency (i.e., the median of every request's end-to-end latency divided by its output length) when varying request load
minimize overall GPU memory waste while ensuring fairness

headline_claim.text: INFERCEPT improves the overall serving throughput by 1.6x-2x and completes 2x more requests per second compared to the state-of-the-art LLM inference systems.

metric_definitions.notes: interception time removed from e2e latency; used as the proxy for serving throughput (sustainable rate at same normalized latency)

metric_definitions.definition_quote: the number of finished requests per second (i.e., throughput)
the time from request arrival to the first generated token (i.e., TTFT)

load_regime: request-rate sweep (Poisson arrivals) on mixed augmentation workload and single-type workloads
tradeoff_acknowledged: vanilla vLLM has better TTFT than some baselines; no explicit InferCept trade-off stated beyond swap/recompute choices
workloads: mixed augmentation workload (math, QA, VE, chatbot, image, TTS)
extractor_notes: Primary stated target is minimizing GPU memory waste from interceptions, translating into throughput/normalized-latency gains. Models field not verified in detail.
